name: cdogs-sdl
why: Classic overhead run-and-gun with a long pedigree, but a GUI game with little that is strange about it.

brief.what_it_is: C-Dogs SDL is a free, open-source classic overhead run-and-gun game, a modern SDL port of the 1997-2001 DOS game C-Dogs. It supports up to 4 players in co-op and deathmatch modes, with customizable players, many weapons, and over 100 user-created campaigns. You play it as a graphical game; the Homebrew formula also installs a second executable, cdogs-sdl-editor, which the README does not describe. Nothing is taken in or produced beyond gameplay and mods.
brief.why_it_exists: The README frames it as keeping a well-loved obscure DOS game playable on modern PCs after its source was released in 2002, and as staying true to the original's vision while adding enhancements like 4-player multiplayer, co-op AI, moddability and new campaigns.
brief.install_notes: The README's easiest route is the itch.io download, which auto-updates through the itch.io app. Building from source needs the SDL2 development libraries and the project's getting-started wiki. Packaging is listed on Repology. Nothing in the README mentions accounts or first-run configuration. The homepage's 2.4.0 and 2.5.0 news posts say the Wolf3D-based mods need a copy of the base game from Steam.
brief.standout: The 2.5.0 release fixes a long-standing bug where the game drew DOS C-Dogs' non-square pixels wrong, so characters now show their intended proportions. The project also ships a Super 2D Noah's Ark mod, a 2D conversion of a Wolf3D-engine game, with a developer retrospective on the homepage.
brief.status: maintained. The homepage lists a 2.5.0 release dated 17 Oct 2026, preceded by 2.4.0 (31 Jan 2026), 2.3.2 (23 Aug 2025) and 2.3.1 (09 Aug 2025). The GitHub repo has active CI badges and an issues tracker.
brief.caveats: The README says the Platforms section covers Windows, Linux and macOS, and that other ports are available but may be outdated. Code is GPLv2 with some BSD 2-clause code, and data is under mixed terms (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA). The homepage's Wolf3D-mod posts say those mods need the separately purchased base game on Steam. The homepage is a blog-style news page, so the README is the better source for features.
quotes: C-Dogs SDL is a classic overhead run-and-gun game, supporting up to 4 players in co-op and deathmatch modes.
Players loved it for its simple yet addictive gameplay and wicked explosions.
So what are you waiting for? Download C-Dogs SDL today and have a blast!
